4 Ways To Use ChatGPT To Find the Best Deals on Major Appliances
Text: [Antonio_Diaz / iStock.comAppliances are expensive.If you’re in the market to replace aging appliances — or simply want to upgrade to your dream washer/dryer combo — you might have noticed that prices have gone a bit crazy in the last few years.I Flip Thrift Store Finds: Here Are the 14 Things I Always Make a Profit OnFind Out: How To Get Cash Back on Your Everyday PurchasesBut before you decide to throw everything on a 29% interest credit card, there are some ways you can use artificial intelligence to make your appliances more affordable. ChatGPT can actually help you find the best deals on appliances, and get you a lower price, too.Here are four ways to use ChatGPT to get the best deal on major appliances.1. Ask ChatGPT About Top Rated BrandsBefore you start shopping for appliances, you can ask ChatGPT to do some research for you. Have ChatGPT give an overview of what brands offer the best quality for the appliance you are looking for. Keep in mind that using ChatGPT 3.5 only has data up to 2021, so you may need to upgrade to ChatGPT Plus for more recent data.See: 8 Major Appliances That Are Wastes of MoneyChatGPT Prompt“What are the best dishwasher brands?”ChatGPT ResponseHere are some dishwasher brands that have historically received positive reviews:Bosch: Bosch dishwashers are known for their quiet operation, energy efficiency and high-quality build. They often come with innovative features and are considered one of the top brands in the market.Miele: Miele is a premium brand that offers high-end dishwashers known for their durability and performance. They are designed to last for many years and usually come with advanced features and technology.KitchenAid: KitchenAid is well-regarded for its well-built and reliable dishwashers. They often offer a good balance of features and price point, making them popular among homeowners.Samsung: Samsung has made a name for itself in the appliance industry, and [its] dishwashers are no exception. They offer modern designs and advanced features, catering to the tech-savvy consumers.Story continuesLG: LG dishwashers have gained popularity for their efficiency and thoughtful features. They often integrate smart technology and modern designs.GE (General Electric): GE dishwashers are known for their solid performance and competitive pricing. [It offers] a wide range of models to suit various budgets and preferences.Whirlpool: Whirlpool is a well-established brand that offers reliable and affordable dishwashers. [It has] a broad selection of models that cater to different needs.Kenmore: Kenmore dishwashers, available at Sears, have been praised for their affordability and reliability.When choosing a dishwasher, it’s essential to consider your specific needs, budget and available features. Reading customer reviews and consulting with appliance experts can help you make an informed decision based on the latest market trends and user experiences.2. Ask ChatGPT To Compare Brands You PreferAfter finding a few brands you like, you can dig in further and ask ChatGPT to compare them. The more information you give ChatGPT about what you want, the better it can compare to help you narrow down your choice.ChatGPT Prompt“Can you compare Bosch, LG and GE dishwashers for me? I want a quiet dishwasher that doesn’t require me to ‘pre-wash’ the dishes before I put them in. I want it easy.”ChatGPT ResponseSure, I’d be happy to compare Bosch, LG and GE dishwashers based on your preferences for quiet operation and the ability to handle dirty dishes without pre-washing. Please note that specific models and features may vary, so it’s essential to check the latest offerings from each brand when making your final decision.Bosch Dishwashers:Quiet Operation: Bosch dishwashers are well-known for their exceptionally quiet operation. Many models are equipped with advanced soundproofing technology and run at noise levels as low as 38-44 decibels, making them among the quietest dishwashers on the market. This is great if you prefer a peaceful kitchen environment.Cleaning Performance: Bosch dishwashers generally have excellent cleaning performance, especially on heavily soiled dishes. They often come with various wash cycles and options, including high-temperature wash and sanitizing cycles to ensure thorough cleaning without the need for pre-rinsing.Ease of Use: Bosch dishwashers typically offer user-friendly interfaces and intuitive controls. Some models come with features like a flexible third rack and adjustable racks, making loading and unloading dishes easier.LG Dishwashers:Quiet Operation: LG also offers dishwashers with low noise levels, generally ranging from 44-48 decibels. While not as quiet as Bosch’s models, they are still relatively silent during operation and suitable for a peaceful kitchen environment.Cleaning Performance: LG dishwashers have advanced cleaning technologies, including multi-motion spray arms and powerful jets, which help in cleaning dishes effectively without pre-washing. They often have multiple wash cycles and settings to cater to different types of loads.Ease of Use: LG designs its dishwashers with user-friendly features and intuitive controls. Some models come with smart connectivity options, allowing you to control the dishwasher remotely and monitor its status.GE Dishwashers:Quiet Operation: GE dishwashers usually operate at noise levels between 45-50 decibels, which is considered relatively quiet and suitable for most households.Cleaning Performance: GE dishwashers often come with advanced wash systems and efficient filtration, ensuring good cleaning results even for dirty dishes. Some models have dedicated jets for heavily soiled items.Ease of Use: GE dishwashers offer straightforward controls and easy-to-use features. They typically have adjustable racks and loading options to accommodate different types of dishes.In summary, all three brands offer dishwashers with quiet operation and effective cleaning performance, making them suitable for your requirements. Bosch is particularly known for its exceptional quietness and reliable cleaning. LG provides advanced cleaning technologies and smart features, while GE offers reliable performance and ease of use. You can compare specific models from each brand that align with your budget and additional feature preferences to find the perfect dishwasher for your needs.3. Ask ChatGPT What Stores Have Deals on the Appliance You WantOnce you find a brand you like, you’ll want to find out where you can find the best deals on appliances. While ChatGPT doesn’t have up-to-date information on all deal websites, it can point you in the right direction.ChatGPT Prompt“Where can I find the best deals on Bosch dishwashers?”ChatGPT ResponseFinding the best deals on Bosch dishwashers will depend on several factors, including your location, the time of year and ongoing promotions. Here are some general tips to help you find great deals on Bosch dishwashers:Authorized Retailers and Websites: Start by checking out authorized Bosch retailers, both online and brick-and-mortar stores. Popular retailers like Home Depot, Lowe’s, Best Buy and Sears… often offer competitive prices and promotions on Bosch dishwashers.Holiday Sales and Special Events: Keep an eye on major holidays and special events like Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Memorial Day, Labor Day and Fourth of July. These occasions often feature significant discounts and promotions on appliances, including dishwashers.Clearance Sales and Floor Models: Visit appliance stores to inquire about clearance sales and floor models. These items are often discounted to make way for new inventory, and floor models may be sold at a reduced price even though they’re in excellent condition.Online Retailers: Check popular online retailers like Amazon, eBay and Overstock for deals on Bosch dishwashers. Sometimes, online sellers may offer better prices than physical stores due to lower overhead costs.Manufacturer’s Website: Visit the official Bosch website to check for any ongoing promotions, rebates or special offers directly from the manufacturer. Bosch occasionally offers incentives, such as cash back or extended warranties.Local Appliance Stores: Don’t forget to explore smaller, local appliance stores in your area. They may have competitive prices and be willing to negotiate deals, especially if you’re purchasing other appliances or considering a package deal.Price Comparison Websites: Use price comparison websites to compare prices from different retailers and find the best deals. Websites like PriceGrabber, Google Shopping or Shopzilla can be helpful in this regard.Sign Up for Newsletters and Alerts: Consider subscribing to newsletters or setting up price alerts on websites to be notified of any upcoming deals or promotions on Bosch dishwashers.Consider Refurbished Models: Bosch-certified refurbished dishwashers can be a more affordable option without compromising on quality. Check with Bosch’s official website or authorized retailers for refurbished models.Always make sure to compare prices and read customer reviews to ensure you’re getting a good deal on a reliable Bosch dishwasher that meets your needs. Keep in mind that availability and pricing may vary depending on your location and the specific model you’re interested in.4. Ask ChatGPT How To Negotiate The PurchaseNow that you have a list of places to compare prices, the last step to getting the best deal on your appliance is negotiating the price. While this can’t really be done when shopping online, you can ask ChatGPT how to haggle a lower price when shopping in person.ChatGPT Prompt“How can I negotiate the lowest price on a dishwasher?”ChatGPT ResponseNegotiating the lowest price on a dishwasher can be an effective way to save money. Here are some tips to help you negotiate a better deal:Do Your Research: Before entering into negotiations, research the market price for the dishwasher model you’re interested in. Look for the average price at different retailers and online stores. This knowledge will give you a better idea of a fair price and provide leverage during negotiations.Compare Prices: Gather quotes from multiple retailers or online stores for the same dishwasher model. Having competing offers allows you to play one seller against another, increasing your chances of getting a better deal.Look for Sales and Promotions: Keep an eye on special sales events, holidays and promotional periods when retailers are more likely to offer discounts. Use these opportunities to negotiate a lower price based on the ongoing promotions.Consider Package Deals: If you’re purchasing multiple appliances or items from the same retailer, inquire about package deals. Retailers might be more willing to negotiate on the price when you’re making a larger purchase.Negotiate in Person: If possible, visit a brick-and-mortar store and negotiate in person. Face-to-face interactions can be more persuasive than negotiating online or over the phone.Be Polite and Respectful: Building rapport with the salesperson can be beneficial. Be polite and respectful during the negotiation process. A positive attitude can go a long way in getting the salesperson on your side.Point Out Flaws: If there are any minor flaws or cosmetic damages on the dishwasher or its packaging, point them out during negotiations. This could give you leverage to request a discount.Mention Competing Offers: If you have received better quotes from other sellers, let the salesperson know about it. Politely ask if they can match or beat the price.Ask for Discounts or Incentives: Inquire about additional discounts, such as price matching, installation discounts or free delivery. Sometimes, retailers offer incentives to close the deal.Be Prepared to Walk Away: If negotiations are not going as expected, be prepared to walk away. Sometimes, showing that you are willing to leave may prompt the seller to offer a better deal to keep your business.Consider Buying Floor Models or Open-Box Items: If the dishwasher is in good condition, buying a floor model or open-box item can lead to significant savings. Ask the retailer about any available options.Remember that negotiation success may vary depending on the retailer, current demand and the specific model you’re interested in. Stay patient and persistent, and don’t be afraid to explore different options to secure the best deal on your desired dishwasher.Bottom LineChatGPT is like your personal shopping assistant, doing instant research for you, coming up with shopping strategies and helping you negotiate a deal on whatever you want to buy. While it can’t quickly give you up-to-date prices on websites, it can give you the strategies for shopping and finding the best deal on the appliance you want.Just keep asking it questions, and it can help guide you in the right direction. But it’s up to you to negotiate and snag the best deal you can find.More From GOBankingRates22 Side Gigs That Can Make You Richer Than a Full-Time JobCan Millennials Afford To Retire If They Never Own a Home?3 Ways to Recession Proof Your Retirement9 Best Small Business Ideas To Make Money From HomeThis article originally appeared on GOBankingRates.com: 4 Ways To Use ChatGPT To Find the Best Deals on Major Appliances]

Title: Calculating The Intrinsic Value Of General Electric Company (NYSE:GE)
Text: [Key InsightsGeneral Electric's estimated fair value is US$125 based on 2 Stage Free Cash Flow to EquityCurrent share price of US$114 suggests General Electric is potentially trading close to its fair value The US$121 analyst price target for GE is 3.1% less than our estimate of fair valueToday we will run through one way of estimating the intrinsic value of General Electric Company (NYSE:GE) by taking the expected future cash flows and discounting them to their present value. We will use the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model on this occasion. Before you think you won't be able to understand it, just read on! It's actually much less complex than you'd imagine.We generally believe that a company's value is the present value of all of the cash it will generate in the future. However, a DCF is just one valuation metric among many, and it is not without flaws. If you want to learn more about discounted cash flow, the rationale behind this calculation can be read in detail in the Simply Wall St analysis model. View our latest analysis for General Electric The ModelWe're using the 2-stage growth model, which simply means we take in account two stages of company's growth. In the initial period the company may have a higher growth rate and the second stage is usually assumed to have a stable growth rate. In the first stage we need to estimate the cash flows to the business over the next ten years. Where possible we use analyst estimates, but when these aren't available we extrapolate the previous free cash flow (FCF) from the last estimate or reported value. We assume companies with shrinking free cash flow will slow their rate of shrinkage, and that companies with growing free cash flow will see their growth rate slow, over this period. We do this to reflect that growth tends to slow more in the early years than it does in later years.A DCF is all about the idea that a dollar in the future is less valuable than a dollar today, so we need to discount the sum of these future cash flows to arrive at a present value estimate:Story continues10-year free cash flow (FCF) estimate2024202520262027202820292030203120322033 Levered FCF ($, Millions) US$5.86bUS$7.09bUS$8.35bUS$8.88bUS$9.29bUS$9.65bUS$9.98bUS$10.3bUS$10.6bUS$10.8bGrowth Rate Estimate SourceAnalyst x5Analyst x4Analyst x2Analyst x2Est @ 4.63%Est @ 3.87%Est @ 3.34%Est @ 2.97%Est @ 2.71%Est @ 2.53% Present Value ($, Millions) Discounted @ 8.4% US$5.4kUS$6.0kUS$6.6kUS$6.4kUS$6.2kUS$5.9kUS$5.7kUS$5.4kUS$5.1kUS$4.8k("Est" = FCF growth rate estimated by Simply Wall St)Present Value of 10-year Cash Flow (PVCF) = US$58bWe now need to calculate the Terminal Value, which accounts for all the future cash flows after this ten year period. The Gordon Growth formula is used to calculate Terminal Value at a future annual growth rate equal to the 5-year average of the 10-year government bond yield of 2.1%. We discount the terminal cash flows to today's value at a cost of equity of 8.4%.Terminal Value (TV)= FCF2033 × (1 + g) ÷ (r – g) = US$11b× (1 + 2.1%) ÷ (8.4%– 2.1%) = US$175bPresent Value of Terminal Value (PVTV)= TV / (1 + r)10= US$175b÷ ( 1 + 8.4%)10= US$78bThe total value, or equity value, is then the sum of the present value of the future cash flows, which in this case is US$135b. The last step is to then divide the equity value by the number of shares outstanding. Relative to the current share price of US$114, the company appears about fair value at a 8.6% discount to where the stock price trades currently. Remember though, that this is just an approximate valuation, and like any complex formula - garbage in, garbage out.dcfImportant AssumptionsThe calculation above is very dependent on two assumptions. The first is the discount rate and the other is the cash flows. You don't have to agree with these inputs, I recommend redoing the calculations yourself and playing with them. The DCF also does not consider the possible cyclicality of an industry, or a company's future capital requirements, so it does not give a full picture of a company's potential performance. Given that we are looking at General Electric as potential shareholders, the cost of equity is used as the discount rate, rather than the cost of capital (or weighted average cost of capital, WACC) which accounts for debt. In this calculation we've used 8.4%, which is based on a levered beta of 1.063. Beta is a measure of a stock's volatility, compared to the market as a whole. We get our beta from the industry average beta of globally comparable companies, with an imposed limit between 0.8 and 2.0, which is a reasonable range for a stable business.SWOT Analysis for General ElectricStrengthDebt is not viewed as a risk.WeaknessDividend is low compared to the top 25% of dividend payers in the Industrials market.OpportunityGood value based on P/E ratio and estimated fair value.ThreatAnnual earnings are forecast to decline for the next 3 years.Next Steps:Although the valuation of a company is important, it shouldn't be the only metric you look at when researching a company. The DCF model is not a perfect stock valuation tool. Rather it should be seen as a guide to "what assumptions need to be true for this stock to be under/overvalued?" If a company grows at a different rate, or if its cost of equity or risk free rate changes sharply, the output can look very different. 4 Ways To Use ChatGPT To Find the Best Deals on Major Appliances
Text: [Antonio_Diaz / iStock.comAppliances are expensive.If you’re in the market to replace aging appliances — or simply want to upgrade to your dream washer/dryer combo — you might have noticed that prices have gone a bit crazy in the last few years.I Flip Thrift Store Finds: Here Are the 14 Things I Always Make a Profit OnFind Out: How To Get Cash Back on Your Everyday PurchasesBut before you decide to throw everything on a 29% interest credit card, there are some ways you can use artificial intelligence to make your appliances more affordable. ChatGPT can actually help you find the best deals on appliances, and get you a lower price, too.Here are four ways to use ChatGPT to get the best deal on major appliances.1. Ask ChatGPT About Top Rated BrandsBefore you start shopping for appliances, you can ask ChatGPT to do some research for you. Have ChatGPT give an overview of what brands offer the best quality for the appliance you are looking for. Keep in mind that using ChatGPT 3.5 only has data up to 2021, so you may need to upgrade to ChatGPT Plus for more recent data.See: 8 Major Appliances That Are Wastes of MoneyChatGPT Prompt“What are the best dishwasher brands?”ChatGPT ResponseHere are some dishwasher brands that have historically received positive reviews:Bosch: Bosch dishwashers are known for their quiet operation, energy efficiency and high-quality build. They often come with innovative features and are considered one of the top brands in the market.Miele: Miele is a premium brand that offers high-end dishwashers known for their durability and performance. They are designed to last for many years and usually come with advanced features and technology.KitchenAid: KitchenAid is well-regarded for its well-built and reliable dishwashers. They often offer a good balance of features and price point, making them popular among homeowners.Samsung: Samsung has made a name for itself in the appliance industry, and [its] dishwashers are no exception. They offer modern designs and advanced features, catering to the tech-savvy consumers.Story continuesLG: LG dishwashers have gained popularity for their efficiency and thoughtful features. They often integrate smart technology and modern designs.GE (General Electric): GE dishwashers are known for their solid performance and competitive pricing. [It offers] a wide range of models to suit various budgets and preferences.Whirlpool: Whirlpool is a well-established brand that offers reliable and affordable dishwashers. [It has] a broad selection of models that cater to different needs.Kenmore: Kenmore dishwashers, available at Sears, have been praised for their affordability and reliability.When choosing a dishwasher, it’s essential to consider your specific needs, budget and available features. Reading customer reviews and consulting with appliance experts can help you make an informed decision based on the latest market trends and user experiences.2. Ask ChatGPT To Compare Brands You PreferAfter finding a few brands you like, you can dig in further and ask ChatGPT to compare them. The more information you give ChatGPT about what you want, the better it can compare to help you narrow down your choice.ChatGPT Prompt“Can you compare Bosch, LG and GE dishwashers for me? I want a quiet dishwasher that doesn’t require me to ‘pre-wash’ the dishes before I put them in. I want it easy.”ChatGPT ResponseSure, I’d be happy to compare Bosch, LG and GE dishwashers based on your preferences for quiet operation and the ability to handle dirty dishes without pre-washing. Please note that specific models and features may vary, so it’s essential to check the latest offerings from each brand when making your final decision.Bosch Dishwashers:Quiet Operation: Bosch dishwashers are well-known for their exceptionally quiet operation. Many models are equipped with advanced soundproofing technology and run at noise levels as low as 38-44 decibels, making them among the quietest dishwashers on the market. This is great if you prefer a peaceful kitchen environment.Cleaning Performance: Bosch dishwashers generally have excellent cleaning performance, especially on heavily soiled dishes. They often come with various wash cycles and options, including high-temperature wash and sanitizing cycles to ensure thorough cleaning without the need for pre-rinsing.Ease of Use: Bosch dishwashers typically offer user-friendly interfaces and intuitive controls. Some models come with features like a flexible third rack and adjustable racks, making loading and unloading dishes easier.LG Dishwashers:Quiet Operation: LG also offers dishwashers with low noise levels, generally ranging from 44-48 decibels. While not as quiet as Bosch’s models, they are still relatively silent during operation and suitable for a peaceful kitchen environment.Cleaning Performance: LG dishwashers have advanced cleaning technologies, including multi-motion spray arms and powerful jets, which help in cleaning dishes effectively without pre-washing. They often have multiple wash cycles and settings to cater to different types of loads.Ease of Use: LG designs its dishwashers with user-friendly features and intuitive controls. Some models come with smart connectivity options, allowing you to control the dishwasher remotely and monitor its status.GE Dishwashers:Quiet Operation: GE dishwashers usually operate at noise levels between 45-50 decibels, which is considered relatively quiet and suitable for most households.Cleaning Performance: GE dishwashers often come with advanced wash systems and efficient filtration, ensuring good cleaning results even for dirty dishes. Some models have dedicated jets for heavily soiled items.Ease of Use: GE dishwashers offer straightforward controls and easy-to-use features. They typically have adjustable racks and loading options to accommodate different types of dishes.In summary, all three brands offer dishwashers with quiet operation and effective cleaning performance, making them suitable for your requirements. Bosch is particularly known for its exceptional quietness and reliable cleaning. LG provides advanced cleaning technologies and smart features, while GE offers reliable performance and ease of use. You can compare specific models from each brand that align with your budget and additional feature preferences to find the perfect dishwasher for your needs.3. Ask ChatGPT What Stores Have Deals on the Appliance You WantOnce you find a brand you like, you’ll want to find out where you can find the best deals on appliances. While ChatGPT doesn’t have up-to-date information on all deal websites, it can point you in the right direction.ChatGPT Prompt“Where can I find the best deals on Bosch dishwashers?”ChatGPT ResponseFinding the best deals on Bosch dishwashers will depend on several factors, including your location, the time of year and ongoing promotions. Here are some general tips to help you find great deals on Bosch dishwashers:Authorized Retailers and Websites: Start by checking out authorized Bosch retailers, both online and brick-and-mortar stores. Popular retailers like Home Depot, Lowe’s, Best Buy and Sears… often offer competitive prices and promotions on Bosch dishwashers.Holiday Sales and Special Events: Keep an eye on major holidays and special events like Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Memorial Day, Labor Day and Fourth of July. These occasions often feature significant discounts and promotions on appliances, including dishwashers.Clearance Sales and Floor Models: Visit appliance stores to inquire about clearance sales and floor models. These items are often discounted to make way for new inventory, and floor models may be sold at a reduced price even though they’re in excellent condition.Online Retailers: Check popular online retailers like Amazon, eBay and Overstock for deals on Bosch dishwashers. Sometimes, online sellers may offer better prices than physical stores due to lower overhead costs.Manufacturer’s Website: Visit the official Bosch website to check for any ongoing promotions, rebates or special offers directly from the manufacturer. Bosch occasionally offers incentives, such as cash back or extended warranties.Local Appliance Stores: Don’t forget to explore smaller, local appliance stores in your area. They may have competitive prices and be willing to negotiate deals, especially if you’re purchasing other appliances or considering a package deal.Price Comparison Websites: Use price comparison websites to compare prices from different retailers and find the best deals. Websites like PriceGrabber, Google Shopping or Shopzilla can be helpful in this regard.Sign Up for Newsletters and Alerts: Consider subscribing to newsletters or setting up price alerts on websites to be notified of any upcoming deals or promotions on Bosch dishwashers.Consider Refurbished Models: Bosch-certified refurbished dishwashers can be a more affordable option without compromising on quality. Check with Bosch’s official website or authorized retailers for refurbished models.Always make sure to compare prices and read customer reviews to ensure you’re getting a good deal on a reliable Bosch dishwasher that meets your needs. Keep in mind that availability and pricing may vary depending on your location and the specific model you’re interested in.4. Ask ChatGPT How To Negotiate The PurchaseNow that you have a list of places to compare prices, the last step to getting the best deal on your appliance is negotiating the price. While this can’t really be done when shopping online, you can ask ChatGPT how to haggle a lower price when shopping in person.ChatGPT Prompt“How can I negotiate the lowest price on a dishwasher?”ChatGPT ResponseNegotiating the lowest price on a dishwasher can be an effective way to save money. Here are some tips to help you negotiate a better deal:Do Your Research: Before entering into negotiations, research the market price for the dishwasher model you’re interested in. Look for the average price at different retailers and online stores. This knowledge will give you a better idea of a fair price and provide leverage during negotiations.Compare Prices: Gather quotes from multiple retailers or online stores for the same dishwasher model. Having competing offers allows you to play one seller against another, increasing your chances of getting a better deal.Look for Sales and Promotions: Keep an eye on special sales events, holidays and promotional periods when retailers are more likely to offer discounts. Use these opportunities to negotiate a lower price based on the ongoing promotions.Consider Package Deals: If you’re purchasing multiple appliances or items from the same retailer, inquire about package deals. Retailers might be more willing to negotiate on the price when you’re making a larger purchase.Negotiate in Person: If possible, visit a brick-and-mortar store and negotiate in person. Face-to-face interactions can be more persuasive than negotiating online or over the phone.Be Polite and Respectful: Building rapport with the salesperson can be beneficial. Be polite and respectful during the negotiation process. A positive attitude can go a long way in getting the salesperson on your side.Point Out Flaws: If there are any minor flaws or cosmetic damages on the dishwasher or its packaging, point them out during negotiations. This could give you leverage to request a discount.Mention Competing Offers: If you have received better quotes from other sellers, let the salesperson know about it. Politely ask if they can match or beat the price.Ask for Discounts or Incentives: Inquire about additional discounts, such as price matching, installation discounts or free delivery. Sometimes, retailers offer incentives to close the deal.Be Prepared to Walk Away: If negotiations are not going as expected, be prepared to walk away. Sometimes, showing that you are willing to leave may prompt the seller to offer a better deal to keep your business.Consider Buying Floor Models or Open-Box Items: If the dishwasher is in good condition, buying a floor model or open-box item can lead to significant savings. Ask the retailer about any available options.Remember that negotiation success may vary depending on the retailer, current demand and the specific model you’re interested in. Stay patient and persistent, and don’t be afraid to explore different options to secure the best deal on your desired dishwasher.Bottom LineChatGPT is like your personal shopping assistant, doing instant research for you, coming up with shopping strategies and helping you negotiate a deal on whatever you want to buy. While it can’t quickly give you up-to-date prices on websites, it can give you the strategies for shopping and finding the best deal on the appliance you want.Just keep asking it questions, and it can help guide you in the right direction. But it’s up to you to negotiate and snag the best deal you can find.More From GOBankingRates22 Side Gigs That Can Make You Richer Than a Full-Time JobCan Millennials Afford To Retire If They Never Own a Home?3 Ways to Recession Proof Your Retirement9 Best Small Business Ideas To Make Money From HomeThis article originally appeared on GOBankingRates.com: 4 Ways To Use ChatGPT To Find the Best Deals on Major Appliances]

Title: Calculating The Intrinsic Value Of General Electric Company (NYSE:GE)
Text: [Key InsightsGeneral Electric's estimated fair value is US$125 based on 2 Stage Free Cash Flow to EquityCurrent share price of US$114 suggests General Electric is potentially trading close to its fair value The US$121 analyst price target for GE is 3.1% less than our estimate of fair valueToday we will run through one way of estimating the intrinsic value of General Electric Company (NYSE:GE) by taking the expected future cash flows and discounting them to their present value. We will use the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model on this occasion. Before you think you won't be able to understand it, just read on! It's actually much less complex than you'd imagine.We generally believe that a company's value is the present value of all of the cash it will generate in the future. However, a DCF is just one valuation metric among many, and it is not without flaws. If you want to learn more about discounted cash flow, the rationale behind this calculation can be read in detail in the Simply Wall St analysis model. View our latest analysis for General Electric The ModelWe're using the 2-stage growth model, which simply means we take in account two stages of company's growth. In the initial period the company may have a higher growth rate and the second stage is usually assumed to have a stable growth rate. In the first stage we need to estimate the cash flows to the business over the next ten years. Where possible we use analyst estimates, but when these aren't available we extrapolate the previous free cash flow (FCF) from the last estimate or reported value. We assume companies with shrinking free cash flow will slow their rate of shrinkage, and that companies with growing free cash flow will see their growth rate slow, over this period. We do this to reflect that growth tends to slow more in the early years than it does in later years.A DCF is all about the idea that a dollar in the future is less valuable than a dollar today, so we need to discount the sum of these future cash flows to arrive at a present value estimate:Story continues10-year free cash flow (FCF) estimate2024202520262027202820292030203120322033 Levered FCF ($, Millions) US$5.86bUS$7.09bUS$8.35bUS$8.88bUS$9.29bUS$9.65bUS$9.98bUS$10.3bUS$10.6bUS$10.8bGrowth Rate Estimate SourceAnalyst x5Analyst x4Analyst x2Analyst x2Est @ 4.63%Est @ 3.87%Est @ 3.34%Est @ 2.97%Est @ 2.71%Est @ 2.53% Present Value ($, Millions) Discounted @ 8.4% US$5.4kUS$6.0kUS$6.6kUS$6.4kUS$6.2kUS$5.9kUS$5.7kUS$5.4kUS$5.1kUS$4.8k("Est" = FCF growth rate estimated by Simply Wall St)Present Value of 10-year Cash Flow (PVCF) = US$58bWe now need to calculate the Terminal Value, which accounts for all the future cash flows after this ten year period. The Gordon Growth formula is used to calculate Terminal Value at a future annual growth rate equal to the 5-year average of the 10-year government bond yield of 2.1%. We discount the terminal cash flows to today's value at a cost of equity of 8.4%.Terminal Value (TV)= FCF2033 × (1 + g) ÷ (r – g) = US$11b× (1 + 2.1%) ÷ (8.4%– 2.1%) = US$175bPresent Value of Terminal Value (PVTV)= TV / (1 + r)10= US$175b÷ ( 1 + 8.4%)10= US$78bThe total value, or equity value, is then the sum of the present value of the future cash flows, which in this case is US$135b. The last step is to then divide the equity value by the number of shares outstanding. Relative to the current share price of US$114, the company appears about fair value at a 8.6% discount to where the stock price trades currently. Remember though, that this is just an approximate valuation, and like any complex formula - garbage in, garbage out.dcfImportant AssumptionsThe calculation above is very dependent on two assumptions. The first is the discount rate and the other is the cash flows. You don't have to agree with these inputs, I recommend redoing the calculations yourself and playing with them. The DCF also does not consider the possible cyclicality of an industry, or a company's future capital requirements, so it does not give a full picture of a company's potential performance. Given that we are looking at General Electric as potential shareholders, the cost of equity is used as the discount rate, rather than the cost of capital (or weighted average cost of capital, WACC) which accounts for debt. In this calculation we've used 8.4%, which is based on a levered beta of 1.063. Beta is a measure of a stock's volatility, compared to the market as a whole. We get our beta from the industry average beta of globally comparable companies, with an imposed limit between 0.8 and 2.0, which is a reasonable range for a stable business.SWOT Analysis for General ElectricStrengthDebt is not viewed as a risk.WeaknessDividend is low compared to the top 25% of dividend payers in the Industrials market.OpportunityGood value based on P/E ratio and estimated fair value.ThreatAnnual earnings are forecast to decline for the next 3 years.Next Steps:Although the valuation of a company is important, it shouldn't be the only metric you look at when researching a company. The DCF model is not a perfect stock valuation tool. Rather it should be seen as a guide to "what assumptions need to be true for this stock to be under/overvalued?" If a company grows at a different rate, or if its cost of equity or risk free rate changes sharply, the output can look very different. For General Electric, we've compiled three additional items you should look at:Risks: We feel that you should assess the 2 warning signs for General Electric (1 doesn't sit too well with us!) we've flagged before making an investment in the company.Future Earnings: How does GE's growth rate compare to its peers and the wider market? Dig deeper into the analyst consensus number for the upcoming years by interacting with our free analyst growth expectation chart.Other Solid Businesses: Low debt, high returns on equity and good past performance are fundamental to a strong business. Why not explore our interactive list of stocks with solid business fundamentals to see if there are other companies you may not have considered!PS. Title: Logistics firm XPO beats profit estimates aided by cost cuts
Text: [Aug 4 (Reuters) - XPO Inc posted a higher-than-expected quarterly profit on Friday, as cost-cutting measures undertaken over the past year helped the logistics firm offset softness in freight volumes.Companies in the logistics sector over the last few quarters have grappled with a decline in shipments, hit by lower demand for their services as consumers returned to in-store shopping patterns in a post-pandemic world.High driver wages and maintenance expenses have also been a drag on the firms' margins, pushing them to embark on cost-control measures to shield profits and remain competitive.Parcel delivery firm FedEx in the last year has grounded planes, shuttered offices and cut jobs in a bid to cut $4 billion in permanent costs by the end of its 2025 financial year.XPO, whose customers include Ford Motor Co, General Electric Co and Caterpillar Inc, posted a per share adjusted profit of 71 cents in the quarter through June, ahead of average analysts estimate of 61 cents per share, as per Refinitiv data.However, its total revenues fell about 6% to $1.92 billion, falling short of average analysts' estimates of $1.94 billion. (Reporting by Priyamvada C in Bengaluru; Editing by Shailesh Kuber)]

4 Ways To Use ChatGPT To Find the Best Deals on Major Appliances
Text: [Antonio_Diaz / iStock.comAppliances are expensive.If you’re in the market to replace aging appliances — or simply want to upgrade to your dream washer/dryer combo — you might have noticed that prices have gone a bit crazy in the last few years.I Flip Thrift Store Finds: Here Are the 14 Things I Always Make a Profit OnFind Out: How To Get Cash Back on Your Everyday PurchasesBut before you decide to throw everything on a 29% interest credit card, there are some ways you can use artificial intelligence to make your appliances more affordable. ChatGPT can actually help you find the best deals on appliances, and get you a lower price, too.Here are four ways to use ChatGPT to get the best deal on major appliances.1. Ask ChatGPT About Top Rated BrandsBefore you start shopping for appliances, you can ask ChatGPT to do some research for you. Have ChatGPT give an overview of what brands offer the best quality for the appliance you are looking for. Keep in mind that using ChatGPT 3.5 only has data up to 2021, so you may need to upgrade to ChatGPT Plus for more recent data.See: 8 Major Appliances That Are Wastes of MoneyChatGPT Prompt“What are the best dishwasher brands?”ChatGPT ResponseHere are some dishwasher brands that have historically received positive reviews:Bosch: Bosch dishwashers are known for their quiet operation, energy efficiency and high-quality build. They often come with innovative features and are considered one of the top brands in the market.Miele: Miele is a premium brand that offers high-end dishwashers known for their durability and performance. They are designed to last for many years and usually come with advanced features and technology.KitchenAid: KitchenAid is well-regarded for its well-built and reliable dishwashers. They often offer a good balance of features and price point, making them popular among homeowners.Samsung: Samsung has made a name for itself in the appliance industry, and [its] dishwashers are no exception. They offer modern designs and advanced features, catering to the tech-savvy consumers.Story continuesLG: LG dishwashers have gained popularity for their efficiency and thoughtful features. They often integrate smart technology and modern designs.GE (General Electric): GE dishwashers are known for their solid performance and competitive pricing. [It offers] a wide range of models to suit various budgets and preferences.Whirlpool: Whirlpool is a well-established brand that offers reliable and affordable dishwashers. [It has] a broad selection of models that cater to different needs.Kenmore: Kenmore dishwashers, available at Sears, have been praised for their affordability and reliability.When choosing a dishwasher, it’s essential to consider your specific needs, budget and available features. Reading customer reviews and consulting with appliance experts can help you make an informed decision based on the latest market trends and user experiences.2. Ask ChatGPT To Compare Brands You PreferAfter finding a few brands you like, you can dig in further and ask ChatGPT to compare them. The more information you give ChatGPT about what you want, the better it can compare to help you narrow down your choice.ChatGPT Prompt“Can you compare Bosch, LG and GE dishwashers for me? I want a quiet dishwasher that doesn’t require me to ‘pre-wash’ the dishes before I put them in. I want it easy.”ChatGPT ResponseSure, I’d be happy to compare Bosch, LG and GE dishwashers based on your preferences for quiet operation and the ability to handle dirty dishes without pre-washing. Please note that specific models and features may vary, so it’s essential to check the latest offerings from each brand when making your final decision.Bosch Dishwashers:Quiet Operation: Bosch dishwashers are well-known for their exceptionally quiet operation. Many models are equipped with advanced soundproofing technology and run at noise levels as low as 38-44 decibels, making them among the quietest dishwashers on the market. This is great if you prefer a peaceful kitchen environment.Cleaning Performance: Bosch dishwashers generally have excellent cleaning performance, especially on heavily soiled dishes. They often come with various wash cycles and options, including high-temperature wash and sanitizing cycles to ensure thorough cleaning without the need for pre-rinsing.Ease of Use: Bosch dishwashers typically offer user-friendly interfaces and intuitive controls. Some models come with features like a flexible third rack and adjustable racks, making loading and unloading dishes easier.LG Dishwashers:Quiet Operation: LG also offers dishwashers with low noise levels, generally ranging from 44-48 decibels. While not as quiet as Bosch’s models, they are still relatively silent during operation and suitable for a peaceful kitchen environment.Cleaning Performance: LG dishwashers have advanced cleaning technologies, including multi-motion spray arms and powerful jets, which help in cleaning dishes effectively without pre-washing. They often have multiple wash cycles and settings to cater to different types of loads.Ease of Use: LG designs its dishwashers with user-friendly features and intuitive controls. Some models come with smart connectivity options, allowing you to control the dishwasher remotely and monitor its status.GE Dishwashers:Quiet Operation: GE dishwashers usually operate at noise levels between 45-50 decibels, which is considered relatively quiet and suitable for most households.Cleaning Performance: GE dishwashers often come with advanced wash systems and efficient filtration, ensuring good cleaning results even for dirty dishes. Some models have dedicated jets for heavily soiled items.Ease of Use: GE dishwashers offer straightforward controls and easy-to-use features. They typically have adjustable racks and loading options to accommodate different types of dishes.In summary, all three brands offer dishwashers with quiet operation and effective cleaning performance, making them suitable for your requirements. Bosch is particularly known for its exceptional quietness and reliable cleaning. LG provides advanced cleaning technologies and smart features, while GE offers reliable performance and ease of use. You can compare specific models from each brand that align with your budget and additional feature preferences to find the perfect dishwasher for your needs.3. Ask ChatGPT What Stores Have Deals on the Appliance You WantOnce you find a brand you like, you’ll want to find out where you can find the best deals on appliances. While ChatGPT doesn’t have up-to-date information on all deal websites, it can point you in the right direction.ChatGPT Prompt“Where can I find the best deals on Bosch dishwashers?”ChatGPT ResponseFinding the best deals on Bosch dishwashers will depend on several factors, including your location, the time of year and ongoing promotions. Here are some general tips to help you find great deals on Bosch dishwashers:Authorized Retailers and Websites: Start by checking out authorized Bosch retailers, both online and brick-and-mortar stores. Popular retailers like Home Depot, Lowe’s, Best Buy and Sears… often offer competitive prices and promotions on Bosch dishwashers.Holiday Sales and Special Events: Keep an eye on major holidays and special events like Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Memorial Day, Labor Day and Fourth of July. These occasions often feature significant discounts and promotions on appliances, including dishwashers.Clearance Sales and Floor Models: Visit appliance stores to inquire about clearance sales and floor models. These items are often discounted to make way for new inventory, and floor models may be sold at a reduced price even though they’re in excellent condition.Online Retailers: Check popular online retailers like Amazon, eBay and Overstock for deals on Bosch dishwashers. Sometimes, online sellers may offer better prices than physical stores due to lower overhead costs.Manufacturer’s Website: Visit the official Bosch website to check for any ongoing promotions, rebates or special offers directly from the manufacturer. Bosch occasionally offers incentives, such as cash back or extended warranties.Local Appliance Stores: Don’t forget to explore smaller, local appliance stores in your area. They may have competitive prices and be willing to negotiate deals, especially if you’re purchasing other appliances or considering a package deal.Price Comparison Websites: Use price comparison websites to compare prices from different retailers and find the best deals. Websites like PriceGrabber, Google Shopping or Shopzilla can be helpful in this regard.Sign Up for Newsletters and Alerts: Consider subscribing to newsletters or setting up price alerts on websites to be notified of any upcoming deals or promotions on Bosch dishwashers.Consider Refurbished Models: Bosch-certified refurbished dishwashers can be a more affordable option without compromising on quality. Check with Bosch’s official website or authorized retailers for refurbished models.Always make sure to compare prices and read customer reviews to ensure you’re getting a good deal on a reliable Bosch dishwasher that meets your needs. Text: [The short-term equity market rally ran out of steam last week as market correction pulled back the growth momentum and triggered a mini slide. Despite signs of a resilient economy with the personal consumption expenditures price index rising 2.6% in the second quarter, moderating inflation with the Federal Reserve hiking interest rates by a quarter percentage point, and solid corporate earnings, the markets appeared to be under “constructive rotation”.The downtrend was further hastened over the past couple of trading sessions with credit rating agency Fitch trimming the long-term foreign currency issuer default rating for the U.S. to AA+ from AAA, citing “expected fiscal deterioration over the next three years”. However, investors have broadly taken the decline on a positive stride as fundamental views about the economy, in general, remain relatively strong.With uncertainty becoming the norm, investors often seek to employ time-tested winning strategies to fetch sustained profits. One of the most successful game plans to beat the blues is to bet on momentum stocks when value or growth investing fails to generate the desired profits.This approach primarily tends to follow the adage, “the trend is your friend.” At its core, momentum investing is “buying high and selling higher.” It is based on the idea that once a stock establishes a trend, it is more likely to continue in that direction because of the momentum that is already behind it. But before we delve deep into it, let us try to fathom why does the momentum strategy at all work?There are several behavioral biases that most investors exhibit in their decision-making. And these emotional responses, or rather mistakes, are the very reason that makes the momentum strategy work.For example, some investors are anxious about booking losses and hence hold on to losing stocks for too long, hopeful of a rebound in prices. On the other hand, a few investors sell their winners way too early. Momentum investing is one of the best strategies to avoid making such errors in judgment.Furthermore, investors initially tend to underreact to news, events or data releases. However, once things become clear, they have a habit of going with the flow and overreacting, causing dramatic price reactions. These behavioral problems extend trends, thus opening up huge opportunities for momentum players.To sum up, momentum investing is a way to profit from the general human tendency to extrapolate current trends into the future. It is based on that gap in time before the mean reversion occurs, i.e., before prices become rational again.In this context, stocks like General Electric Company GE, Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd. Title: Logistics firm XPO beats profit estimates aided by cost cuts
Text: [Aug 4 (Reuters) - XPO Inc posted a higher-than-expected quarterly profit on Friday, as cost-cutting measures undertaken over the past year helped the logistics firm offset softness in freight volumes.Companies in the logistics sector over the last few quarters have grappled with a decline in shipments, hit by lower demand for their services as consumers returned to in-store shopping patterns in a post-pandemic world.High driver wages and maintenance expenses have also been a drag on the firms' margins, pushing them to embark on cost-control measures to shield profits and remain competitive.Parcel delivery firm FedEx in the last year has grounded planes, shuttered offices and cut jobs in a bid to cut $4 billion in permanent costs by the end of its 2025 financial year.XPO, whose customers include Ford Motor Co, General Electric Co and Caterpillar Inc, posted a per share adjusted profit of 71 cents in the quarter through June, ahead of average analysts estimate of 61 cents per share, as per Refinitiv data.However, its total revenues fell about 6% to $1.92 billion, falling short of average analysts' estimates of $1.94 billion. (Reporting by Priyamvada C in Bengaluru; Editing by Shailesh Kuber)]

Text: [The short-term equity market rally ran out of steam last week as market correction pulled back the growth momentum and triggered a mini slide. Despite signs of a resilient economy with the personal consumption expenditures price index rising 2.6% in the second quarter, moderating inflation with the Federal Reserve hiking interest rates by a quarter percentage point, and solid corporate earnings, the markets appeared to be under “constructive rotation”.The downtrend was further hastened over the past couple of trading sessions with credit rating agency Fitch trimming the long-term foreign currency issuer default rating for the U.S. to AA+ from AAA, citing “expected fiscal deterioration over the next three years”. One of the most successful game plans to beat the blues is to bet on momentum stocks when value or growth investing fails to generate the desired profits.This approach primarily tends to follow the adage, “the trend is your friend.” At its core, momentum investing is “buying high and selling higher.” It is based on the idea that once a stock establishes a trend, it is more likely to continue in that direction because of the momentum that is already behind it. But before we delve deep into it, let us try to fathom why does the momentum strategy at all work?There are several behavioral biases that most investors exhibit in their decision-making. And these emotional responses, or rather mistakes, are the very reason that makes the momentum strategy work.For example, some investors are anxious about booking losses and hence hold on to losing stocks for too long, hopeful of a rebound in prices. Title: Logistics firm XPO beats profit estimates aided by cost cuts
Text: [Aug 4 (Reuters) - XPO Inc posted a higher-than-expected quarterly profit on Friday, as cost-cutting measures undertaken over the past year helped the logistics firm offset softness in freight volumes.Companies in the logistics sector over the last few quarters have grappled with a decline in shipments, hit by lower demand for their services as consumers returned to in-store shopping patterns in a post-pandemic world.High driver wages and maintenance expenses have also been a drag on the firms' margins, pushing them to embark on cost-control measures to shield profits and remain competitive.Parcel delivery firm FedEx in the last year has grounded planes, shuttered offices and cut jobs in a bid to cut $4 billion in permanent costs by the end of its 2025 financial year.XPO, whose customers include Ford Motor Co, General Electric Co and Caterpillar Inc, posted a per share adjusted profit of 71 cents in the quarter through June, ahead of average analysts estimate of 61 cents per share, as per Refinitiv data.However, its total revenues fell about 6% to $1.92 billion, falling short of average analysts' estimates of $1.94 billion. (Reporting by Priyamvada C in Bengaluru; Editing by Shailesh Kuber)]

Title: Logistics firm XPO beats profit estimates aided by cost cuts
Text: [Aug 4 (Reuters) - XPO Inc posted a higher-than-expected quarterly profit on Friday, as cost-cutting measures undertaken over the past year helped the logistics firm offset softness in freight volumes.Companies in the logistics sector over the last few quarters have grappled with a decline in shipments, hit by lower demand for their services as consumers returned to in-store shopping patterns in a post-pandemic world.High driver wages and maintenance expenses have also been a drag on the firms' margins, pushing them to embark on cost-control measures to shield profits and remain competitive.Parcel delivery firm FedEx in the last year has grounded planes, shuttered offices and cut jobs in a bid to cut $4 billion in permanent costs by the end of its 2025 financial year.XPO, whose customers include Ford Motor Co, General Electric Co and Caterpillar Inc, posted a per share adjusted profit of 71 cents in the quarter through June, ahead of average analysts estimate of 61 cents per share, as per Refinitiv data.However, its total revenues fell about 6% to $1.92 billion, falling short of average analysts' estimates of $1.94 billion. (Reporting by Priyamvada C in Bengaluru; Editing by Shailesh Kuber)]

Text: [(Updates paragraphs 4,7 on government statement, EDF's response)LONDON, Aug 7 (Reuters) - The British government on Monday raised potential national security concerns from French state-owned utility EDF's deal to buy General Electric's nuclear turbine business, ordering the companies to meet certain security needs.EDF's bid to acquire the GE Steam Power business from the U.S. conglomerate was cleared by Britain's antitrust regulator in May 2023 after an initial investigation."The Secretary of State considers that a risk to national security will arise because of the critical national security and defence capabilities relating to naval propulsion systems which are delivered through (the GE unit)," the government said.The government considers that the order is "necessary and proportionate to mitigate the risk to national security," the statement added.Issuing a final order on EDF's deal to buy the unit via a subsidiary called GEAST UK, the government asked the companies to meet physical and information security requirements and implement governance arrangements to protect sensitive information.It said a government-appointed board observer must be placed on the board of GEAST UK to observe meetings, while also asking the companies to maintain capacity and capability in respect of critical Ministry of Defence programmes in Britain.EDF declined to comment and GE did not immediately respond to a request for comment. (Reporting by Muvija M in London and Ananta Agarwal in Bengaluru; Editing by Paul Simao and Grant McCool)]

Title: Logistics firm XPO beats profit estimates aided by cost cuts
Text: [Aug 4 (Reuters) - XPO Inc posted a higher-than-expected quarterly profit on Friday, as cost-cutting measures undertaken over the past year helped the logistics firm offset softness in freight volumes.Companies in the logistics sector over the last few quarters have grappled with a decline in shipments, hit by lower demand for their services as consumers returned to in-store shopping patterns in a post-pandemic world.High driver wages and maintenance expenses have also been a drag on the firms' margins, pushing them to embark on cost-control measures to shield profits and remain competitive.Parcel delivery firm FedEx in the last year has grounded planes, shuttered offices and cut jobs in a bid to cut $4 billion in permanent costs by the end of its 2025 financial year.XPO, whose customers include Ford Motor Co, General Electric Co and Caterpillar Inc, posted a per share adjusted profit of 71 cents in the quarter through June, ahead of average analysts estimate of 61 cents per share, as per Refinitiv data.However, its total revenues fell about 6% to $1.92 billion, falling short of average analysts' estimates of $1.94 billion. (Reporting by Priyamvada C in Bengaluru; Editing by Shailesh Kuber)]

Title: Analyst Report: General Electric Company
UPDATE 2-UK raises national security concerns over EDF deal to buy GE unit
Text: [(Updates paragraphs 4,7 on government statement, EDF's response)LONDON, Aug 7 (Reuters) - The British government on Monday raised potential national security concerns from French state-owned utility EDF's deal to buy General Electric's nuclear turbine business, ordering the companies to meet certain security needs.EDF's bid to acquire the GE Steam Power business from the U.S. conglomerate was cleared by Britain's antitrust regulator in May 2023 after an initial investigation."The Secretary of State considers that a risk to national security will arise because of the critical national security and defence capabilities relating to naval propulsion systems which are delivered through (the GE unit)," the government said.The government considers that the order is "necessary and proportionate to mitigate the risk to national security," the statement added.Issuing a final order on EDF's deal to buy the unit via a subsidiary called GEAST UK, the government asked the companies to meet physical and information security requirements and implement governance arrangements to protect sensitive information.It said a government-appointed board observer must be placed on the board of GEAST UK to observe meetings, while also asking the companies to maintain capacity and capability in respect of critical Ministry of Defence programmes in Britain.EDF declined to comment and GE did not immediately respond to a request for comment. (Reporting by Muvija M in London and Ananta Agarwal in Bengaluru; Editing by Paul Simao and Grant McCool)]

Text: [This article will talk about the 20 biggest Internet of Things Companies in the world. We have also covered interesting discussions on different IoT applications. If you want to skip our detailed analysis, head straight to the 5 Biggest Internet of Things Companies in the World. As of 2022, the global Internet of Things (IoT) market was valued at around $544 billion. It's also estimated to grow significantly in the coming years, with projections indicating it will reach approximately $662 billion in 2023 and a whopping $3.35 trillion by 2030. This impressive growth is expected to result in a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 26.1% during the forecast period.Many big players in the industry, like Cisco Systems Inc (NASDAQ:CSCO), and Siemens AG, have been providing IoT platforms and solutions from deployment services to smart city initiatives and industrial edge solutions. These technologies enable the interconnection of devices using different communication technologies that offer valuable interoperable information without human intervention. If we are to speak about the biggest IoT products in the market, smart watches, smart refrigerators, medical sensors, and fitness trackers would all make it to the list. To read more about the impact of digitalization and artificial intelligence, you should check out our article on Jobs That Will Disappear in the Future Due to AI.How is IoT Making Waves in Industries?IoT has become a pertinent game changer in the healthcare industry by transforming surgical display technology. Through interconnected devices, IoT-enabled surgical displays can integrate data from various medical sources that can provide surgeons with a comprehensive view during medical procedures. Not only does real-time data sharing foster collaboration among medical professionals, it has also added to the quality of patient care and decision-making. Moreover, IoT has facilitated remote monitoring and troubleshooting of displays which has largely reduced downtime and ensures continuous functionality.Story continuesThe generosity of IoT services is not limited to the healthcare sector. In fact, it has tapped into the unexplored potential in urban transportation. The combination of electric bikes (e-bikes) and the Internet of Things (IoT) has been a win-win idea as E-bikes offer a sustainable and efficient alternative to traditional commuting with addressing issues like traffic and pollution. On the other hand, IoT technology enhances e-bikes by providing real-time tracking, remote diagnostics, and seamless integration with other transport options through apps. This data also helps improve urban planning for better infrastructure and traffic management.Challenges for the Internet of Things to Look Out ForThe biggest challenge that comes with the IoT is the implementation of IoT security in the rapidly growing Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem. As IoT integrates the physical world with computer-based systems, the attack surfaces and vulnerabilities increase and hence, attracts malicious actors. In industrial settings, the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) is especially critical but harder to secure due to long-standing, hard-to-upgrade components with limited maintenance windows.Existing IoT cybersecurity standards from organizations like NIST and ISA are complex which also makes implementation harder as technical documentation for some security standards runs over thousands of pages. Moreover, harmonizing security for both older "brownfield" and new "greenfield" systems is equally complicated and complex.Another challenge is that government regulations often lag the rapid evolution of IoT technology which leaves businesses without essential information to make decisions. The absence of robust IoT regulations contributes to its security risks, especially as critical devices like medical equipment and cars become connected.Quality control is challenging due to the influx of IoT devices from countries like China that have varying security standards. Thus, experts advocate for strong and universal security standards to address these concerns, as the potential attack surface expands to include more crucial devices. Moreover, the lack of sufficient regulation can raise eyebrows and lead to potential disaster scenarios in the IoT landscape.Let's now move to the biggest IoT companies in the world.20 Biggest Internet of Things Companies in the WorldZapp2Photo/Shutterstock.comOur MethodologyThe methodology used to rank the Biggest Internet of Things Companies in the world is based on the annual revenue generated by IoT companies in 2022. UPDATE 2-UK raises national security concerns over EDF deal to buy GE unit
Text: [(Updates paragraphs 4,7 on government statement, EDF's response)LONDON, Aug 7 (Reuters) - The British government on Monday raised potential national security concerns from French state-owned utility EDF's deal to buy General Electric's nuclear turbine business, ordering the companies to meet certain security needs.EDF's bid to acquire the GE Steam Power business from the U.S. conglomerate was cleared by Britain's antitrust regulator in May 2023 after an initial investigation."The Secretary of State considers that a risk to national security will arise because of the critical national security and defence capabilities relating to naval propulsion systems which are delivered through (the GE unit)," the government said.The government considers that the order is "necessary and proportionate to mitigate the risk to national security," the statement added.Issuing a final order on EDF's deal to buy the unit via a subsidiary called GEAST UK, the government asked the companies to meet physical and information security requirements and implement governance arrangements to protect sensitive information.It said a government-appointed board observer must be placed on the board of GEAST UK to observe meetings, while also asking the companies to maintain capacity and capability in respect of critical Ministry of Defence programmes in Britain.EDF declined to comment and GE did not immediately respond to a request for comment. (Reporting by Muvija M in London and Ananta Agarwal in Bengaluru; Editing by Paul Simao and Grant McCool)]

As of 2022, the global Internet of Things (IoT) market was valued at around $544 billion. It's also estimated to grow significantly in the coming years, with projections indicating it will reach approximately $662 billion in 2023 and a whopping $3.35 trillion by 2030. This impressive growth is expected to result in a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 26.1% during the forecast period.Many big players in the industry, like Cisco Systems Inc (NASDAQ:CSCO), and Siemens AG, have been providing IoT platforms and solutions from deployment services to smart city initiatives and industrial edge solutions. These technologies enable the interconnection of devices using different communication technologies that offer valuable interoperable information without human intervention. Through interconnected devices, IoT-enabled surgical displays can integrate data from various medical sources that can provide surgeons with a comprehensive view during medical procedures. Not only does real-time data sharing foster collaboration among medical professionals, it has also added to the quality of patient care and decision-making. Moreover, IoT has facilitated remote monitoring and troubleshooting of displays which has largely reduced downtime and ensures continuous functionality.Story continuesThe generosity of IoT services is not limited to the healthcare sector. In fact, it has tapped into the unexplored potential in urban transportation. The combination of electric bikes (e-bikes) and the Internet of Things (IoT) has been a win-win idea as E-bikes offer a sustainable and efficient alternative to traditional commuting with addressing issues like traffic and pollution. On the other hand, IoT technology enhances e-bikes by providing real-time tracking, remote diagnostics, and seamless integration with other transport options through apps. This data also helps improve urban planning for better infrastructure and traffic management.Challenges for the Internet of Things to Look Out ForThe biggest challenge that comes with the IoT is the implementation of IoT security in the rapidly growing Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem. As IoT integrates the physical world with computer-based systems, the attack surfaces and vulnerabilities increase and hence, attracts malicious actors. In industrial settings, the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) is especially critical but harder to secure due to long-standing, hard-to-upgrade components with limited maintenance windows.Existing IoT cybersecurity standards from organizations like NIST and ISA are complex which also makes implementation harder as technical documentation for some security standards runs over thousands of pages. Moreover, harmonizing security for both older "brownfield" and new "greenfield" systems is equally complicated and complex.Another challenge is that government regulations often lag the rapid evolution of IoT technology which leaves businesses without essential information to make decisions. The absence of robust IoT regulations contributes to its security risks, especially as critical devices like medical equipment and cars become connected.Quality control is challenging due to the influx of IoT devices from countries like China that have varying security standards. Text: [(Updates paragraphs 4,7 on government statement, EDF's response)LONDON, Aug 7 (Reuters) - The British government on Monday raised potential national security concerns from French state-owned utility EDF's deal to buy General Electric's nuclear turbine business, ordering the companies to meet certain security needs.EDF's bid to acquire the GE Steam Power business from the U.S. conglomerate was cleared by Britain's antitrust regulator in May 2023 after an initial investigation."The Secretary of State considers that a risk to national security will arise because of the critical national security and defence capabilities relating to naval propulsion systems which are delivered through (the GE unit)," the government said.The government considers that the order is "necessary and proportionate to mitigate the risk to national security," the statement added.Issuing a final order on EDF's deal to buy the unit via a subsidiary called GEAST UK, the government asked the companies to meet physical and information security requirements and implement governance arrangements to protect sensitive information.It said a government-appointed board observer must be placed on the board of GEAST UK to observe meetings, while also asking the companies to maintain capacity and capability in respect of critical Ministry of Defence programmes in Britain.EDF declined to comment and GE did not immediately respond to a request for comment. (Reporting by Muvija M in London and Ananta Agarwal in Bengaluru; Editing by Paul Simao and Grant McCool)]

Title: 20 Biggest Internet of Things Companies in the World
Text: [This article will talk about the 20 biggest Internet of Things Companies in the world. We have also covered interesting discussions on different IoT applications. If you want to skip our detailed analysis, head straight to the 5 Biggest Internet of Things Companies in the World. As of 2022, the global Internet of Things (IoT) market was valued at around $544 billion. It's also estimated to grow significantly in the coming years, with projections indicating it will reach approximately $662 billion in 2023 and a whopping $3.35 trillion by 2030. This impressive growth is expected to result in a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 26.1% during the forecast period.Many big players in the industry, like Cisco Systems Inc (NASDAQ:CSCO), and Siemens AG, have been providing IoT platforms and solutions from deployment services to smart city initiatives and industrial edge solutions. These technologies enable the interconnection of devices using different communication technologies that offer valuable interoperable information without human intervention. If we are to speak about the biggest IoT products in the market, smart watches, smart refrigerators, medical sensors, and fitness trackers would all make it to the list. To read more about the impact of digitalization and artificial intelligence, you should check out our article on Jobs That Will Disappear in the Future Due to AI.How is IoT Making Waves in Industries?IoT has become a pertinent game changer in the healthcare industry by transforming surgical display technology. Through interconnected devices, IoT-enabled surgical displays can integrate data from various medical sources that can provide surgeons with a comprehensive view during medical procedures. Not only does real-time data sharing foster collaboration among medical professionals, it has also added to the quality of patient care and decision-making. Moreover, IoT has facilitated remote monitoring and troubleshooting of displays which has largely reduced downtime and ensures continuous functionality.Story continuesThe generosity of IoT services is not limited to the healthcare sector. In fact, it has tapped into the unexplored potential in urban transportation. The combination of electric bikes (e-bikes) and the Internet of Things (IoT) has been a win-win idea as E-bikes offer a sustainable and efficient alternative to traditional commuting with addressing issues like traffic and pollution. On the other hand, IoT technology enhances e-bikes by providing real-time tracking, remote diagnostics, and seamless integration with other transport options through apps. This data also helps improve urban planning for better infrastructure and traffic management.Challenges for the Internet of Things to Look Out ForThe biggest challenge that comes with the IoT is the implementation of IoT security in the rapidly growing Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem. As IoT integrates the physical world with computer-based systems, the attack surfaces and vulnerabilities increase and hence, attracts malicious actors. In industrial settings, the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) is especially critical but harder to secure due to long-standing, hard-to-upgrade components with limited maintenance windows.Existing IoT cybersecurity standards from organizations like NIST and ISA are complex which also makes implementation harder as technical documentation for some security standards runs over thousands of pages. Moreover, harmonizing security for both older "brownfield" and new "greenfield" systems is equally complicated and complex.Another challenge is that government regulations often lag the rapid evolution of IoT technology which leaves businesses without essential information to make decisions. The absence of robust IoT regulations contributes to its security risks, especially as critical devices like medical equipment and cars become connected.Quality control is challenging due to the influx of IoT devices from countries like China that have varying security standards. Thus, experts advocate for strong and universal security standards to address these concerns, as the potential attack surface expands to include more crucial devices. Moreover, the lack of sufficient regulation can raise eyebrows and lead to potential disaster scenarios in the IoT landscape.Let's now move to the biggest IoT companies in the world.20 Biggest Internet of Things Companies in the WorldZapp2Photo/Shutterstock.comOur MethodologyThe methodology used to rank the Biggest Internet of Things Companies in the world is based on the annual revenue generated by IoT companies in 2022.
